# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

## NOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE

Reconnaitre l’importance de la responsabilité, du vivant, et de la durabilité, nous pousse à nous
transformer. Agir vite et bien. Pour accompagner nos clients acteurs du changement, Robertet façonne
le Naturel du futur.

[Futuring Naturals][61]

## ROBERTET X ASSOULINE

À l’occasion de son 175ᵉ anniversaire, Robertet dévoile un ouvrage d’exception édité par Assouline,
maison reconnue pour ses livres dédiés à l’art, au luxe et au patrimoine.

Disponible sur le site d’Assouline, ce livre retrace l’histoire singulière de Robertet, depuis ses
origines à Grasse jusqu’à son rayonnement international. À travers des archives inédites, des
témoignages et des images exclusives, il met en lumière l’héritage, le savoir-faire et la passion du
naturel qui animent le Groupe depuis 1850.

Plus qu’un livre anniversaire, cet ouvrage incarne l’ADN de Robertet : l’excellence, la créativité
et un engagement constant en faveur d’une innovation responsable, tournée vers l’avenir.

Véritable objet de collection, cette édition célèbre la transmission d’un savoir-faire unique et
rend hommage aux femmes et aux hommes qui font vivre la Maison depuis cinq générations.

[Découvrir][62]

## ROBERTET INVESTIT DANS AETHERA BIOTECH

Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer l’investissement stratégique de Robertet dans Aethera Biotech, pionnier
européen des ingrédients cosmétiques actifs.

Cette étape marque notre entrée dans le domaine des biotechnologies végétales et renforce notre
stratégie « Augmented Naturality ». En combinant la technologie brevetée CROP® d’Aethera Biotech
avec l’expertise mondiale et la portée commerciale de Robertet Group, nous accélérerons l’innovation
dans les actifs cosmétiques et soutiendrons la croissance à long terme de notre division Health &
Beauty.

Une nouvelle étape pour réunir la nature et la science de pointe.

[Interview : Olivier Maubert][63]

## ECOVADIS : STATUT PLATINIUM

Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer que Robertet renforce son score EcoVadis.

Après avoir obtenu l’an dernier la médaille Platine avec un score de 83/100, Robertet a encore
progressé cette année en atteignant 88/100.

Cette distinction, attribuée aux entreprises figurant dans le Top 1 % mondial, reconnaît la qualité
et la solidité du système de management de la durabilité de notre Groupe. L’évaluation EcoVadis
repose sur quatre domaines clés : l’Environnement, le Social & Droits Humains, l’Éthique et les
Achats Responsables.

Cette progression illustre la détermination de Robertet à aller toujours plus loin dans l’alliance
entre performance et responsabilité.

Nous remercions l’ensemble de nos équipes pour leur engagement collectif et quotidien, et plus
particulièrement notre Directrice RSE, pour son dévouement constant dans cette réussite.

## RÉSULTATS ANNUELS 2025.

En 2025, Robertet a enregistré une nouvelle année de croissance avec un chiffre d’affaires de 843,9
M€, en progression organique de 7,6 %, et un EBITDA de 174 M€, représentant une marge de 20,6 %.

Malgré un contexte économique mondial incertain, ces résultats reflètent la solidité du modèle du
Groupe, porté par son expertise du naturel, son agilité et sa dynamique d’innovation.

Ils confirment également la pertinence de la stratégie de développement de Robertet et renforcent sa
confiance dans ses ambitions à l’horizon 2030.

[Rapport financier annuel][64]

## CLEAN R SCENT : Nouvelle génération d’absolues

CleanRscent est la nouvelle gamme d’absolues éco-conçues de Robertet, basée sur une technologie
brevetée, offrant une réponse immédiate aux demandes des clients et du marché pour une parfumerie
plus responsable. Ouvrant une voie d’avenir pour les absolues, ingrédients emblématiques de la
parfumerie, cleanRscent offre une haute performance olfactive avec un profil authentique « True to
Nature » et une signature unique pour des parfums éco-conçus, 100% sans résidus d’hexane.

## NOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE

Reconnaitre l’importance de la responsabilité, du vivant, et de la durabilité, nous pousse à nous
transformer. Agir vite et bien. Pour accompagner nos clients acteurs du changement, Robertet façonne
le Naturel du futur.

[Futuring Naturals][61]

## ROBERTET X ASSOULINE

À l’occasion de son 175ᵉ anniversaire, Robertet dévoile un ouvrage d’exception édité par Assouline,
maison reconnue pour ses livres dédiés à l’art, au luxe et au patrimoine.

Disponible sur le site d’Assouline, ce livre retrace l’histoire singulière de Robertet, depuis ses
origines à Grasse jusqu’à son rayonnement international. À travers des archives inédites, des
témoignages et des images exclusives, il met en lumière l’héritage, le savoir-faire et la passion du
naturel qui animent le Groupe depuis 1850.

Plus qu’un livre anniversaire, cet ouvrage incarne l’ADN de Robertet : l’excellence, la créativité
et un engagement constant en faveur d’une innovation responsable, tournée vers l’avenir.

Véritable objet de collection, cette édition célèbre la transmission d’un savoir-faire unique et
rend hommage aux femmes et aux hommes qui font vivre la Maison depuis cinq générations.

[Découvrir][62]

## ROBERTET INVESTIT DANS AETHERA BIOTECH

Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer l’investissement stratégique de Robertet dans Aethera Biotech, pionnier
européen des ingrédients cosmétiques actifs.

Cette étape marque notre entrée dans le domaine des biotechnologies végétales et renforce notre
stratégie « Augmented Naturality ». En combinant la technologie brevetée CROP® d’Aethera Biotech
avec l’expertise mondiale et la portée commerciale de Robertet Group, nous accélérerons l’innovation
dans les actifs cosmétiques et soutiendrons la croissance à long terme de notre division Health &
Beauty.

Une nouvelle étape pour réunir la nature et la science de pointe.

[Interview : Olivier Maubert][63]

## ECOVADIS : STATUT PLATINIUM

Nous sommes ravis d’annoncer que Robertet renforce son score EcoVadis.

Après avoir obtenu l’an dernier la médaille Platine avec un score de 83/100, Robertet a encore
progressé cette année en atteignant 88/100.

Cette distinction, attribuée aux entreprises figurant dans le Top 1 % mondial, reconnaît la qualité
et la solidité du système de management de la durabilité de notre Groupe. L’évaluation EcoVadis
repose sur quatre domaines clés : l’Environnement, le Social & Droits Humains, l’Éthique et les
Achats Responsables.

Cette progression illustre la détermination de Robertet à aller toujours plus loin dans l’alliance
entre performance et responsabilité.

Nous remercions l’ensemble de nos équipes pour leur engagement collectif et quotidien, et plus
particulièrement notre Directrice RSE, pour son dévouement constant dans cette réussite.

## INAUGURATION – CENTRE CREATIF AU BRESIL

Le Brésil occupe une place stratégique dans le développement de Robertet et constitue l’un des plus
grands marchés mondiaux des parfums et des arômes.

L’inauguration de notre Creative Center, l’un des plus importants du Groupe, marque une nouvelle
étape de notre développement en Amérique latine.

Pensé comme un véritable lieu d’innovation et de co-création, il nous permet de renforcer notre
proximité avec nos clients et d’accompagner le développement de solutions en parfumerie, arômes et
ingrédients naturels, au plus près des besoins du marché local.

## RÉSULTATS ANNUELS 2025.

En 2025, Robertet a enregistré une nouvelle année de croissance avec un chiffre d’affaires de 843,9
M€, en progression organique de 7,6 %, et un EBITDA de 174 M€, représentant une marge de 20,6 %.

Malgré un contexte économique mondial incertain, ces résultats reflètent la solidité du modèle du
Groupe, porté par son expertise du naturel, son agilité et sa dynamique d’innovation.

Ils confirment également la pertinence de la stratégie de développement de Robertet et renforcent sa
confiance dans ses ambitions à l’horizon 2030.

[Rapport financier annuel][64]

## CLEAN R SCENT : Nouvelle génération d’absolues

CleanRscent est la nouvelle gamme d’absolues éco-conçues de Robertet, basée sur une technologie
brevetée, offrant une réponse immédiate aux demandes des clients et du marché pour une parfumerie
plus responsable. Ouvrant une voie d’avenir pour les absolues, ingrédients emblématiques de la
parfumerie, cleanRscent offre une haute performance olfactive avec un profil authentique « True to
Nature » et une signature unique pour des parfums éco-conçus, 100% sans résidus d’hexane.

## la puissance d’un groupe industriel indépendant

La vision d’entreprise de Robertet s’inscrit dans le long terme et tisse des liens durables. Elle
offre des repères stables et s’appuie sur des valeurs responsables.

# A Leading Perfume Designer And Fragrance Supply Company

Alpha Aromatics is an international perfume designer, creating and supplying high-quality scents for
some of the most respected and innovative brands in the marketplace. We develop organic, natural,
and designer fragrance compositions for fine perfumes, personal care products, candles, diffusers,
aerosols, industrial cleaners, home products, and more. We also offer advanced molecular odor
neutralizing additives and malodor counteractants that effectively eliminate unpleasant odors at the
source. With decades of experience blending fragrances for products and product lines, we serve
manufacturers, private label brands, custom packaging companies, toll blenders, and others—helping
you create the perfect new, natural, organic, or synthetic scent for your brand.

[Contact our team today][16]!  +1 (412) 252-1012 / +1 (800) 295-5261

[Alpha Aromatics Logo]


## Fragrances For Products And Product Lines


### **We Build Great Scents That Build Great Brands!**

As a fragrance designer and supply company whose routes stretch as far back as the 1940s, Alpha
Aromatics has been making the world smell better one customized scent at a time for more than seven
decades. Every day, the fragrances we create touch the lives of people around the world.

We understand and respect the power of scent as one might revere the eternal supremacy of the ocean.
Our clients come to us for our captivating and unique [fragrance compositions][17], created layer by
layer by some of the most talented artisans in the scent industry.

Let us do what we do best and revolutionize your product line with our own special melange of
ambient branding.  Explore [our company history][18], professional affiliations and management team.

### **Apply For A Job With Alpha Aromatics!**

We are actively looking for applicants to join the Alpha Aromatic family — [Please Apply here][19]

 

 


### Our Industry Expertise Raises The Bar Above The Competition

We specialize in [synthetic][20], natural and organic fragrance sectors to accommodate the needs of
all industries concerned with utilizing ambient branding to improve their bottom line.

Headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, we manufacture a vast array of scent-related products
that run the gamut from [fine fragrances][21], private label brands, [personal care
products][22] and [candles and diffusers][23] to household [cleaning products][24], industrial and
institutional air fresheners, [hand sanitizers][25] and so much more.

Our perfume designers are never satisfied until our customers are. Always striving to do better than
the competition, our mission is to be the best we can be and our expertise is constantly evolving to
meet the complex and sophisticated demands of our valued customers.

We are armed with cutting edge technologies, state-of-the-art laboratories and the widest, most
effective selection of [molecular odor counteractive additives][26] on the market today.

 

 


### Perfume Design For Any Unique Fragrance Application

Alpha Aromatics is unique in more ways than one. With all the global presence and prestige of a
globally-recognized leader in fragrance creation, we are still as customized for the needs of any
sized company from start-ups to multi-national firms.

Each customer, regardless of their size and branding project, gets our total attention and care
unlike any other available today. We can also offer in-house fragrance manufacturing that includes
customized packaging and filling services for start up projects.

We specialize in unique fragrance creation and understand the power of scent. We strive to innovate
with our clients, particularly retailers, on how they can best enhance their bottom line and build
brands with fragrance marketing products, concepts and ideas.

We nurture creativity and encourage scientific innovation, while priding ourselves on adhering to
the highest levels of perfumery ethics and regulatory standards in the world.

 

 


### Our Professional Affiliations

Over the course of the last seventy years, Alpha Aromatics has made many professional allies within
the dynamic perfume industry. Dedicated to a sustainable and ecologically stable planet Earth, we
share our mission, where ambivalence has no place, with other caring professional who feel the same
way.

An old axiom claims that *birds of a feather stick together* meaning that judgement comes form the
company we keep, and in the case of Alpha Aromatics, our friends are the best in the business.

In ad

Washington, DC, where it serves as the industry watchdog on regulatory and legislative issues.

[[ISO PRI Programs Accredited]][34]

 

 


 

## **We Write About What We Love
## And We Love Creating Fragrances**

 

Dive into the art and science of fragrance, where we explore everything from the creation of
exquisite scents to the latest trends in fragrance supply. Whether you’re a seasoned perfumer or
simply passionate about all things aromatic, our blog is your ultimate resource. View our latest
posts below or [peruse our entire blog][35] and discover the fascinating world of fragrance. Happy
reading!

 

 

## [ The Art Of Crafting Odor Slaying Scents For Toilet Sprays][36]

Toilet spray fragrances, unlike traditional perfumery, target harsh human odors. They use
limonene-rich citrus oils—lemon, orange, bergamot, lime, tangerine—in top notes to neutralize odors.
Middle and base notes enhance these odor-fighters. We’ll cover how these scents fight odors and
shame, highlight seven effective toilet spray fragrances, and discuss our pioneering toilet surface
spray technology, now a major air freshening market segment.

[Continue Reading][37]

## [ Perfume Making 101 – Mastering The Art Of Blending Perfumes][38]

Perfume blending merges art and science to create unique fragrances using natural and synthetic
ingredients to craft harmonious fragrances. In the following, we explore the key
components—essential oils, synthetics, solvents, fixatives—and processes like gas chromatography and
enfleurage, highlighting the balance, creativity, and expertise that defines this masterful craft.

We specialize in unique fragrance creation and understand the power of scent. We strive to innovate
with our clients, particularly retailers, on how they can best enhance their bottom line and build
brands with fragrance marketing products, concepts and ideas.

We nurture creativity and encourage scientific innovation, while priding ourselves on adhering to
the highest levels of perfumery ethics and regulatory standards in the world.

 

 


### Our Professional Affiliations

Over the course of the last seventy years, Alpha Aromatics has made many professional allies within
the dynamic perfume industry. Dedicated to a sustainable and ecologically stable planet Earth, we
share our mission, where ambivalence has no place, with other caring professional who feel the same
way.

An old axiom claims that *birds of a feather stick together* meaning that judgement comes form the
company we keep, and in the case of Alpha Aromatics, our friends are the best in the business.

In addition to being **[ISO 9001:2015 Certified][27]**, we are members of and meet every
environmental and quality standard set by the Research Institute of Fragrance Materials
([RIFM][28]), the International Fragrance Association ([IFRA)][29], [Oregon Tilth][30], the
Worldwide Cleaning Industry Association ([ISSA][31]) and one of our most prestigious affiliates is
the [Natural Products Association][32] aka NPA. Founded in 1936, this is the oldest non-profit
organization dedicated to the natural products industry. NPA has a strong lobbying presence in
Washington, DC, where it serves as the industry watchdog on regulatory and legislative issues.

Another important Alpha connection is the [Society of Cosmetic Chemists][33], which is a research
foundation located in New York City. Dedicated to the advancement of cosmetic science, Alpha has
benefited from the dissemination of their scientific information, which has helped to make our
company a true leader in cutting edge fragrance technologies. Some of our other important
affiliations include:

[[ISO PRI Programs Accredited]][34]

 

 


 

## **We Write About What We Love
## And We Love Creating Fragrances**

 

Dive into the art and science of fragrance, where we explore everything from the creation of
exquisite scents to the latest trends in fragrance supply. Whether you’re a seasoned perfumer or
simply passionate about all things aromatic, our blog is your ultimate resource. View our latest
posts below or [peruse our entire blog][35] and discover the fascinating world of fragrance. Happy
reading!

 

 

## [ The Art Of Crafting Odor Slaying Scents For Toilet Sprays][36]

Toilet spray fragrances, unlike traditional perfumery, target harsh human odors. They use
limonene-rich citrus oils—lemon, orange, bergamot, lime, tangerine—in top notes to neutralize odors.
Middle and base notes enhance these odor-fighters. We’ll cover how these scents fight odors and
shame, highlight seven effective toilet spray fragrances, and discuss our pioneering toilet surface
spray technology, now a major air freshening market segment.

[Continue Reading][37]

## [ Perfume Making 101 – Mastering The Art Of Blending Perfumes][38]

Perfume blending merges art and science to create unique fragrances using natural and synthetic
ingredients to craft harmonious fragrances. In the following, we explore the key
components—essential oils, synthetics, solvents, fixatives—and processes like gas chromatography and
enfleurage, highlighting the balance, creativity, and expertise that defines this masterful craft.

[Continue Reading][39]

### FAQ: : Aromatic Chemicals in Fragrance Creation

[ What are Aromatic Chemicals? ][178]

Aroma Chemicals are odorous chemical compounds with varying degrees of strength, stability,
tenacity. They are primary building blocks of a Fragrance and are the result of advancements in
synthetic chemistry.

[ What are Natural Aroma Chemicals? ][179]

Natural Aroma Chemicals can be called as Isolates, where in a specific molecular compound is
enriched from a natural source. Most common examples include, Geraniol ex Palmarosa Essential Oil,
Rhodinal ex Geranium etc

[ What are Synthetic Aroma Chemicals? ][180]

These are Synthetic Chemicals that manufactured in a laboratory via Chemical or Biological
processes. For example, Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol, Amyl Acetate etc.

[ Who manufactures Aroma Chemicals? ][181]

There are many manufacturers globally  such as IFF, Symrise, BASF, Solvay, DSM etc and there are
many in each region.

### FAQ: Essential Oils, Pure vs Reconstituted Essential Oils & Aromatherapy

[ What are Essential Oils? ][182]

Essential Oils are volatile oils obtained from plant materials by different methods (distillation,
solvent extraction, cold press etc)

[ What are Pure Essential Oils ][183]
* Pure Essential Oil indicates that an oil is in its purest form without any additional
  solvents/enhancing aromatic chemicals etc.
* Distillation, Solvent Extraction, Cold Press, Enfleurage are some of the methods used in the
  extraction of Natural Oils.
[ What are Reconstituted Essential Oils (RCOs) ][184]

Reconstituted Oils are recreations with synthetic aroma chemicals (found in nature). In most cases
they have a significant portion of the the natural oils too. 

[ Essential oils in Aromatherapy? ][185]
* The health effects of pure natural oils have been established via published research and through
  historical citations. The word 'Aromatherapy' means Healing through Aroma. It involves trained
  certified therapists using the right selection of pure oils for treating various health
  conditions.
* Please note that, there has been widespread misuse in labelling several products that are just
  aromachemicals or reconstituted oils as 'Aromatherapy' products.

### FAQ: : Aromatic Chemicals in Fragrance Creation

[ What are Aromatic Chemicals? ][178]

Aroma Chemicals are odorous chemical compounds with varying degrees of strength, stability,
tenacity. They are primary building blocks of a Fragrance and are the result of advancements in
synthetic chemistry.

[ What are Natural Aroma Chemicals? ][179]

Natural Aroma Chemicals can be called as Isolates, where in a specific molecular compound is
enriched from a natural source. Most common examples include, Geraniol ex Palmarosa Essential Oil,
Rhodinal ex Geranium etc

[ What are Synthetic Aroma Chemicals? ][180]

These are Synthetic Chemicals that manufactured in a laboratory via Chemical or Biological
processes. For example, Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol, Amyl Acetate etc.

[ Who manufactures Aroma Chemicals? ][181]

There are many manufacturers globally  such as IFF, Symrise, BASF, Solvay, DSM etc and there are
many in each region.

### FAQ: Essential Oils, Pure vs Reconstituted Essential Oils & Aromatherapy

[ What are Essential Oils? ][182]

Essential Oils are volatile oils obtained from plant materials by different methods (distillation,
solvent extraction, cold press etc)

[ What are Pure Essential Oils ][183]
* Pure Essential Oil indicates that an oil is in its purest form without any additional
  solvents/enhancing aromatic chemicals etc.
* Distillation, Solvent Extraction, Cold Press, Enfleurage are some of the methods used in the
  extraction of Natural Oils.
[ What are Reconstituted Essential Oils (RCOs) ][184]

Reconstituted Oils are recreations with synthetic aroma chemicals (found in nature). In most cases
they have a significant portion of the the natural oils too. 

[ Essential oils in Aromatherapy? ][185]
* The health effects of pure natural oils have been established via published research and through
  historical citations. The word 'Aromatherapy' means Healing through Aroma. It involves trained
  certified therapists using the right selection of pure oils for treating various health
  conditions.
* Please note that, there has been widespread misuse in labelling several products that are just
  aromachemicals or reconstituted oils as 'Aromatherapy' products.

## [The materials science of tennis][22]

[ July 13, 2026 ][23] [0Comments][24] [2Likes][25] [5489Views][26]
[[An infographic titled "The materials science of tennis" by Compound Interest explaining the
chemistry of balls and rackets. Ball cores are vulcanized rubber (natural rubber crosslinked with
sulfur) filled with pressurized nitrogen gas. The outer felt is wool and nylon, dyed yellow with a
dye such as Basic Yellow 40. Rackets evolved from wood (which warped), to aluminium, then composites
(fibreglass, Kevlar), and now carbon fibre with plastic resins. Strings transitioned from cow gut to
polyester and nylon.]][27]Click to enlarge

If you’ve been enjoying the tennis at Wimbledon over the past two weeks, chemistry probably didn’t
cross your mind as you watched the players slogging the ball back and forth. However, a lot of
science and honed materials go into both the rackets and balls used during each game, set and match.
This graphic examines the key substances used and how they’ve changed over time.

[Read more][28]

## [The chemistry of the 2026 World Cup ball][29]

[ June 12, 2026 ][30] [0Comments][31] [15Likes][32] [17041Views][33]
[[Infographic titled "The chemistry of the World Cup ball" by Compound Interest. It details the
materials used in manufacturing. Polyurethane coating forms the water-resistant outer panels,
synthesized from isocyanate and polyol. A nylon lining (polyamide) adds bounce and strength between
the cover and bladder. The inner butyl rubber bladder retains air effectively, though latex is an
alternative.]][34]Click to enlarge

The 2026 World Cup is up and running, but not without its share of controversy. It’s setting a
number of unwelcome firsts: the first time a [World Cup referee has been barred from a host
nation][35], and the first time [a host nation is at war with one of the participating
countries][36]. However, some slightly more welcome firsts come in the shape of the materials
science behind the World Cup ball, the Trionda.

## Our Vision

Make people feel better everywhere

[eternis.com]

## Fragrance story

The world of fragrance and the impact it has on human life is nothing short of fascinating. When
aroma molecules in a perfume interact with the olfactory receptors of the human nose, there is this
extraordinary awakening of the senses. What we at Eternis do, is manufacture the aroma chemicals
that go into this world of perfumery- the start of all that magic.

[eternis.com]

## The Eternis edge

We strive for success in very simple ways. We listen, we anticipate and we deliver. Eternis has some
of the brightest minds working tirelessly to ensure we stay ahead of the curve. The result? A growth
from USD 15 million to USD 70 million in a decade.

[eternis.com]

## Sustainability

For us, each day is an opportunity to do something positive for the earth. We conduct our operations
in an environmentally sound manner and ensure that whether it is production, sourcing, marketing, or
employee engagement - all of our practices are directed towards achieving the highest sustainability
standards.

# A Leading Supplier of Citrus and Pine Ingredients From Renewable Sources

[Aerial view of Florachem in Jacksonville, Florida]Aerial view of Florachem in Jacksonville, Florida

We are a leader in the manufacture, sourcing, and supply of citrus, pine and other plant-based
ingredients. Marketed under Florachem brands, our products help customers improve performance, EH&S
properties, and economics in diverse markets such as coatings, industrial cleaning, oilfield
services and personal care. 

Our Citrus portfolio includes d-Limonene grades, FloraSolv™ d-Limonene alternatives, cold press
orange oil, folded orange oil, lemon and lime specialties. 

From Pine, we supply various grades of terpineol, pine oil, and dipentene, gum turpentine and
camphene.  We market a line of specialty rosin resins, including hydrogenated rosin esters, under
FloraRez™ brand.  

Our bio-based FloraDyme™ dimer and trimer acid products are made from cottonseed oil.  

We offer select aroma ingredients, citrus and pine ingredients, and essential oils to flavor and
fragrance compounders.

development and scale-up, ensuring consistent quality and reliable supply. We are committed to
supporting your unique needs with tailored solutions and long-term value.

At Gem Aromatics, we are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in the world of
essential oils and aroma chemicals. Our commitment to innovation ensures that we remain at the
forefront of the industry, delivering superior products and services to our clients.

Our commitment ensures that every essential oil and aroma chemical meets the highest standards. We
adhere to both domestic and international regulations, providing our customers with products they
can trust.

##### Вопросы и ответы

Ответы на самые распространённые вопросы о продукции, условиях сотрудничества и разработке
индивидуальных ароматических решений.

[Все вопросы][144]

**Предоставляете ли вы образцы?**

Образцы предоставляются единоразово 10 шт физическим лицам и 20 шт юридическим лицам. Доставка
образцов осуществляется за счёт клиента, также возможен самовывоз из нашего офиса. В случае, если
Вам нужно большее количество образцов, Вы можете обратиться к нашим розничным партнёрам и приобрести
отдушку у них. Мы образцы не продаем. Образцы предоставляются единоразово 10 шт физическим лицам с
заказом

**Какие сертификаты вы предоставляете на отдушки?**

На отдушки французского производства мы предоставляем: сертификат безопасности (MSDS), лист
аллергенов, спецификацию (TDS), сертификат IFRA, паспорт качества на партию и пирамиду ароматов. На
российские отдушки мы предоставляем: сертификат безопасности (MSDS), лист аллергенов, спецификацию
(TDS), паспорт качества на партию и пирамиду ароматов. Часть документов вы можете найти в разделе
документы

**Есть ли у вас в ассортименте гипоаллергенные отдушки?**

В нашем складском ассортименте есть коллекция гипоаллергенных отдушек. У них есть отметка L26, а
также в наименовании данных отдушек есть слово «гипоаллергенный». Данные отдушки обычно используются
в косметике и средствах гигиены для детей, а также в гипоаллергенной косметике.

**Занимаетесь ли вы разработками под заказ?**

У нас есть своя лаборатория и команда технологов-парфюмеров. Мы разрабатываем отдушки и пищевые
ароматизаторы под заказ по техническому заданию бесплатно при условии закупки одной позиции от 50
кг. Мы не предоставляем эксклюзивные права на разработанные нами ароматы под заказ, не передаем
формулы и не изготавливаем отдушки и ароматизаторы по готовым формулам. Любая разработанная нами
отдушка может попасть в складской ассортимент.

**Какая у вас минимальная сумма заказа?**

Минимальная сумма заказа 20.000 руб. Минимальное количество одного наименования для заказа: 1 кг
(отдушки, эфирные масла). Для стран СНГ минимальная сумма заказа с НДС 0% 50.000,00 рублей, но также
Вы можете оформить заказ по стандартной минимальной сумме заказа с НДС 20%.

**Какие у вас сроки отгрузки после оплаты заказа?**

При условии наличия товара на складе срок сборки заказа после поступления денежных средств на наш
расчетный счет составляет 3-5 рабочих дней в зависимости от загруженности склада. Чтобы ускорить
процесс отгрузки просим Вас отправлять платежное поручение/чек об оплате своему менеджеру.

##### Вопросы и ответы

Ответы на самые распространённые вопросы о продукции, условиях сотрудничества и разработке
индивидуальных ароматических решений.

[Все вопросы][144]

**Предоставляете ли вы образцы?**

Образцы предоставляются единоразово 10 шт физическим лицам и 20 шт юридическим лицам. Доставка
образцов осуществляется за счёт клиента, также возможен самовывоз из нашего офиса. В случае, если
Вам нужно большее количество образцов, Вы можете обратиться к нашим розничным партнёрам и приобрести
отдушку у них. Мы образцы не продаем. Образцы предоставляются единоразово 10 шт физическим лицам с
заказом

**Какие сертификаты вы предоставляете на отдушки?**

На отдушки французского производства мы предоставляем: сертификат безопасности (MSDS), лист
аллергенов, спецификацию (TDS), сертификат IFRA, паспорт качества на партию и пирамиду ароматов. На
российские отдушки мы предоставляем: сертификат безопасности (MSDS), лист аллергенов, спецификацию
(TDS), паспорт качества на партию и пирамиду ароматов. Часть документов вы можете найти в разделе
документы

**Есть ли у вас в ассортименте гипоаллергенные отдушки?**

В нашем складском ассортименте есть коллекция гипоаллергенных отдушек. У них есть отметка L26, а
также в наименовании данных отдушек есть слово «гипоаллергенный». Данные отдушки обычно используются
в косметике и средствах гигиены для детей, а также в гипоаллергенной косметике.

**Занимаетесь ли вы разработками под заказ?**

У нас есть своя лаборатория и команда технологов-парфюмеров. Мы разрабатываем отдушки и пищевые
ароматизаторы под заказ по техническому заданию бесплатно при условии закупки одной позиции от 50
кг. Мы не предоставляем эксклюзивные права на разработанные нами ароматы под заказ, не передаем
формулы и не изготавливаем отдушки и ароматизаторы по готовым формулам. Любая разработанная нами
отдушка может попасть в складской ассортимент.

**Какая у вас минимальная сумма заказа?**

Минимальная сумма заказа 20.000 руб. Минимальное количество одного наименования для заказа: 1 кг
(отдушки, эфирные масла). Для стран СНГ минимальная сумма заказа с НДС 0% 50.000,00 рублей, но также
Вы можете оформить заказ по стандартной минимальной сумме заказа с НДС 20%.

**Какие у вас сроки отгрузки после оплаты заказа?**

При условии наличия товара на складе срок сборки заказа после поступления денежных средств на наш
расчетный счет составляет 3-5 рабочих дней в зависимости от загруженности склада. Чтобы ускорить
процесс отгрузки просим Вас отправлять платежное поручение/чек об оплате своему менеджеру.
